task_specification.objective: Plan exactly two bounded implementation tasks that advance both required release-convergence gaps, allocate each active issue once, and make the required HUD choice hierarchy and arena spatial-integrity capabilities directly retestable.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release candidate has two active integration defects—automatic attack/dash audio causality and Warden/mausoleum camera occlusion—while the frozen phase gates still require a complete upgrade-choice transaction and HUD presentation. The repair should be split into HUD/combat feedback and authored-arena spatial integration.

stop_conditions: Do not schedule deferred dense-run native qualification or unrelated backlog gaps.
Do not replace preserved assets or perform destructive authored-map surgery.
Stop after candidate implementation and instrumentation are ready for host recapture and Tester closure.

strategy.rationale: Use two coherent root-cause families: repair product-owned HUD/upgrade state binding plus automatic-combat audio routing; separately repair authored-map anchors, collision, and camera framing. This preserves the native project and retained weapon component while addressing both active player-facing defects.

code: Run focused static/unit checks for HUD transaction state, combat event/audio routing, camera framing, and arena collision/anchor scripts; confirm no parse errors.
Verify preserved validate:native_godot_project and validate:host_godot_boot baselines remain passing.
runtime: Host recaptures upgrade draft open/select/commit at runtime with current run level/build identity and keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.

Host captures one SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap with mixed-output WAV plus event timeline, confirming one bounded firearm transient per action, independent dash cue, and no post-release/reset sustain.

Host performs sparse world probes at spawn, critical route, cardinal/landmark, and boundary views during ordinary movement/movement replay, checking larger traversable scale, external depth, central building/landmark visibility, collision, perimeter/boundary containment, and no disappearance/occlusion.

Host reruns validate:release_convergence_experience_upgrade_transaction_contract, validate:release_convergence_survivor_hud_presentation_contract, validate:native_godot_project, and validate:host_godot_boot; Tester owns pass/fail and issue closure.
visual: Inspect draft screenshots for authored hierarchy, silhouettes, compact icons, truthful deltas, restrained copy, and focus visibility.
Inspect gameplay/world screenshots for unobstructed Warden/mausoleum framing, stable landmark/perimeter visibility, coherent external depth, and absence of proxy-floor or placeholder artifacts.

done_when: Upgrade draft uses weapon/upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, no NEW/LOCKED placeholder in CURRENT values, restrained copy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.
A normal run can open, select, and commit an upgrade through authoritative run state, with visible post-commit build identity.

One SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap each yield exactly one bounded recognizable firearm transient in mixed output; dash has an independent bounded cue; release/reset stops sustained cues and enemy spatial reports remain separate.
Tester has direct black-box and white-box retest hooks for draft transaction and audio causality.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned upgrade draft and combat-feedback integration. Bind the existing draft UI to authoritative choice/commit state and present the required visual hierarchy (silhouette, compact icons, truthful deltas, focus states) without placeholder CURRENT values. Trace the attack/effects path so SEMI and quick AUTO each emit one short firearm transient, dash emits its own cue, and release/lifecycle reset clears sustained audio; preserve the retained weapon component/audio and adjust only adapter, routing, envelope, or proven material-impact suppression. Add only focused candidate-owned receipts/logging needed for direct transaction/audio retest.
tasks.title: Repair upgrade transaction HUD and automatic combat feedback

done_when: The existing cemetery remains one intact authored environment instance supplying streets/terrain, buildings, props, materials, and landmarks.
The playable arena has larger traversable scale (expand bounds as needed) and coherent external world/external depth beyond the play space.
The central building/landmark and perimeter/boundary retain stable visibility during ordinary movement/movement replay; no disappearance or occlusion drift occurs.
Collision is aligned for the central building and perimeter/boundary, preventing pass-through or leakage outside the play space.
Camera framing keeps the Warden readable near the mausoleum while spawn/objective anchors sit on authored streets, not proxy clutter.
Tester can directly retest spawn, landmark, collision, boundary, and visibility with sparse world probes.
